paraphrase: Hard to obtain is even the name of Avalokiteśvara: those who recollect his six-syllable vidyā are born in his pores and no longer wander in saṃsāra.

paraphrase: The six-syllable great vidyā, oṃ maṇipadme hūṃ, is Avalokiteśvara's innermost heart, hard to obtain; whoever knows it is freed; even the buddhas sought it.
